Package de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map

Class Bomb

java.lang.Object
de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map.GameObject
de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map.Bomb
All Implemented Interfaces:
Drawable
public class Bomb extends GameObject
The Bomb class represents a bomb object in the BomberQuest game. A bomb has a fuse time, blast radius, and interacts with the game map to create explosions that affect destructible and indestructible walls, as well as the player.

Features of this class include:

  • Handling the bomb's countdown fuse timer.
  • Triggering explosions in specified directions based on the blast radius.
  • Interacting with the game map to destroy walls and end the game if the player is hit.
  • Providing the current visual appearance of the bomb.
